name: SecurityDashboard
title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/SecurityDashboard
summary: The security dashboard pattern: blocked and allowed requests over time, breakdowns by attack category and origin, the top sources and an attention list. A row of three StatTiles (Requests blocked, Requests inspected, Block rate, each with its delta against the previous period and a sparkline) sits over a 12-column grid of ChartCards. Matched requests over time plots blocked and logged requests; Needs attention lists the settings and traffic that ask for a decision, each with a severity Tag and one action Link; attack categories and countries read as ranked BarLists, and the top source IPs as a searchable, paginated TableRoot. With no rule set in place the tiles stay as dashes and one setup EmptyState that offers Add rule set replaces the grid. Built from `PageHeader`, `StatTile`, `ChartCard`, `Chart`, `BarList`, `Item`, `Tag`, `Link`, `TableRoot`, `Hint`, `ToggleGroup`, `DropdownMenu`, `Skeleton`, `EmptyState` and `Button`.
